24    public function __construct()
25    {
26        if (!Auth::isInTimeMode())
27            return;
28
29        $this->currentSession = $this->fetchTable('TimeModeSession')->find()->where([
30            'user_id' => Auth::getUserID(),
31            'time_mode_session_status_id' => TimeModeSessionStatusTable::IN_PROGRESS])->first();
32
33        if (!$this->currentSession)
34            return;
35
36        // is TimeModeUtil::PROBLEM_COUNT normally, but can be less when not enough problems found
37        $attempts = $this->fetchTable('TimeModeAttempt')->find()->where(['time_mode_session_id' => $this->currentSession->id])->toArray();
38        $recordedCount = 0;
39        foreach ($attempts as $attempt)
40        {
41            if ($attempt->time_mode_attempt_status_id == TimeModeAttemptStatusTable::SOLVED)
42                $this->successCount++;
43            elseif (
44                $attempt->time_mode_attempt_status_id == TimeModeAttemptStatusTable::FAILED
45                || $attempt->time_mode_attempt_status_id == TimeModeAttemptStatusTable::SKIPPED
46                || $attempt->time_mode_attempt_status_id == TimeModeAttemptStatusTable::TIMEOUT)
47                    $this->failCount++;
48            if ($attempt->time_mode_attempt_status_id != TimeModeAttemptStatusTable::QUEUED)
49                $recordedCount++;
50        }
51        $this->overallCount = count($attempts);
52
53        if ($this->overallCount == 0)
54        {
55            $this->cancelTimeMode();
56            return;
57        }
58
59        $this->currentOrder = $recordedCount + 1;
60
61        // the run of a challenge has the time the challenge gives, a run of the time mode the time of its category
62        if ($challengeID = $this->currentSession->challenge_id)
63        {
64            $challenge = $this->fetchTable('Challenge')->get($challengeID);
65            $this->challenge = $challenge;
66            $this->overallSecondsToSolve = $challenge->seconds_per_problem;
67            return;
68        }
69        $this->rank = $this->fetchTable('TimeModeRank')->find()->where(['id' => $this->currentSession->time_mode_rank_id])->first();
70        $category = $this->fetchTable('TimeModeCategory')->get($this->currentSession->time_mode_category_id);
71        $this->overallSecondsToSolve = $category->seconds;
72    }

74    public function startTimeMode(int $categoryID, int $rankID): void
75    {
76        $relevantTsumegos = $this->getRelevantTsumegos($rankID);
77        if (empty($relevantTsumegos))
78            throw new InternalErrorException('No relevant tsumegos.');
79        $this->leaveCurrentSession();
80        shuffle($relevantTsumegos);
81        $currentTimeSession = $this->createNewSession($categoryID, $rankID);
82        $this->createSessionAttempts($currentTimeSession->id, array_column(array_slice($relevantTsumegos, 0, TimeModeUtil::PROBLEM_COUNT), 'id'));
83    }
84
85    //Starts the run of the current player in a challenge: the problems of the challenge in its
86    //order, each with the time the challenge gives. A player has one run in a challenge.
87    /** @param array<string, mixed> $challenge */
88    public function startChallenge(array $challenge): void
89    {
90        $tsumegoIDs = ChallengeTable::problemIDs((int) $challenge['id']);
91        if (empty($tsumegoIDs))
92            throw new InternalErrorException('The challenge has no problems.');
93        $this->leaveCurrentSession();
94        $session = $this->createSession(['challenge_id' => $challenge['id']]);
95        self::bumpChallengeOf($session);
96        $this->createSessionAttempts($session->id, $tsumegoIDs);
97    }

99    public static function cancelTimeMode(): void
100    {
101        TableRegistry::getTableLocator()->get('TimeModeSession')->deleteAll(['user_id' => Auth::getUserID(), 'time_mode_session_status_id' => TimeModeSessionStatusTable::IN_PROGRESS]);

104    //Makes way for a new run. A run of the time mode left unfinished is thrown away. The run of a
105    //challenge can't be, since the player knows its problems now and would play them again: it
106    //ends with the problems left unplayed, which get no points.
107    private function leaveCurrentSession(): void
108    {
109        $sessionTable = $this->fetchTable('TimeModeSession');
110        $sessionTable->deleteAll([
111            'user_id' => Auth::getUserID(),
112            'time_mode_session_status_id' => TimeModeSessionStatusTable::IN_PROGRESS,
113            'challenge_id IS' => null]);
114        $challengeSessions = $sessionTable->find()->where([
115            'user_id' => Auth::getUserID(),
116            'time_mode_session_status_id' => TimeModeSessionStatusTable::IN_PROGRESS])->toArray();
117        foreach ($challengeSessions as $challengeSession)
118            self::giveUp($challengeSession);
119    }

121    //Ends a run with whatever it has: every problem not played yet counts as skipped.
122    private static function giveUp(TimeModeSession $session): void
123    {
124        $attemptTable = TableRegistry::getTableLocator()->get('TimeModeAttempt');
125        $queuedAttempts = $attemptTable->find()->where([
126            'time_mode_session_id' => $session->id,
127            'time_mode_attempt_status_id' => TimeModeAttemptStatusTable::QUEUED])->toArray();
128        foreach ($queuedAttempts as $attempt)
129            self::recordAttempt($attempt, TimeModeAttemptStatusTable::SKIPPED, 0, 0);
130        self::score($session);

133    private function createNewSession(int $categoryID, int $rankID): TimeModeSession
134    {

143    }

157    public static function getRatingBounds(?int $timeModeRankID): RatingBounds
158    {
159        $timeModeRankTable = TableRegistry::getTableLocator()->get('TimeModeRank');
160
161        // I'm assuming, that the entries in the time_mode_rank tables have primary id ordered in the same order as the ranks, so the next entry
162        // is the higher rank, and the previous is the lower (checked in testTimeModeRankContentsIntegrity)
163        // This allows me to figure out what range should I cover by the current rank, which is
164        // <max_of_smaller_rank or 0 if it doesn't exit, max_of_current_rank if next rank exists or infinity]
165        // this should put every tsumego in some of the rank intervals regardless of the ranks configuration
166        $result = new RatingBounds();
167        $smallerRank = $timeModeRankTable->find()->where(['id <' => $timeModeRankID])->orderByDesc('id')->first();
168        if ($smallerRank)
169            $result->min = self::ratingAbove($smallerRank->name);
170
171        if ($timeModeRankTable->exists(['id >' => $timeModeRankID]))
172            $result->max = self::ratingAbove($timeModeRankTable->get($timeModeRankID)->name);
173
174        return $result;
175    }

177    //The rating where the problems of a time mode rank end: the minimal rating of the next rank.
178    private static function ratingAbove(string $rankName): float
179    {
180        return Rating::getRankMinimalRating(Rating::GetRankFromReadableRank($rankName) + 1);
181    }
182
183    //How many problems a run of each rank can draw, by time mode rank id, in one query: every problem
184    //counts in the rank whose rating bounds (getRatingBounds()) hold it.
185    /**
186     * @param TimeModeRank[] $ranks every rank, ordered by id
187     * @return array<int, int>
188     */
189    public static function countTsumegosByRank(array $ranks): array
190    {
191        if (!$ranks)
192            return [];
193        $lastRank = array_pop($ranks);
194        $bucket = (string) $lastRank->id;
195        if ($ranks)
196            $bucket = 'CASE ' . implode(' ', array_map(
197                fn(TimeModeRank $rank) => 'WHEN tsumego.rating < ' . self::ratingAbove($rank->name) . ' THEN ' . $rank->id,
198                $ranks)) . ' ELSE ' . $lastRank->id . ' END';
199        $counts = [];
200        foreach (Util::query('SELECT ' . $bucket . ' AS rank_id, COUNT(DISTINCT tsumego.id) AS count' . self::drawablePoolSql() . ' GROUP BY rank_id') as $row)
201            $counts[(int) $row['rank_id']] = (int) $row['count'];
202        foreach ([...$ranks, $lastRank] as $rank)
203            $counts[$rank->id] ??= 0;
204        return $counts;
205    }

207    private function getRelevantTsumegos(int $timeModeRankID): array
208    {
209        return self::getTsumegosInRatingBounds(self::getRatingBounds($timeModeRankID));
210    }

212    //The problems the time mode draws from, of the ranks from one to another (both included).
213    /** @return array<array{id: int}> */
214    public static function getTsumegosOfRanks(int $minimumTimeModeRankID, int $maximumTimeModeRankID): array
215    {
216        return self::getTsumegosInRatingBounds(new RatingBounds(
217            self::getRatingBounds($minimumTimeModeRankID)->min,
218            self::getRatingBounds($maximumTimeModeRankID)->max));
219    }

221    /** @return array<array{id: int}> */
222    private static function getTsumegosInRatingBounds(RatingBounds $ratingBounds): array
223    {
224        $query = 'SELECT DISTINCT tsumego.id as id' . self::drawablePoolSql();
225        if ($ratingBounds->min)
226            $query .= " AND rating >= " . $ratingBounds->min;
227        if ($ratingBounds->max)
228            $query .= " AND rating < " . $ratingBounds->max;
229        return Util::query($query);
230    }

232    //The FROM and WHERE of the problems a run of the time mode draws from: not deleted, in an official collection that is in the time mode.
233    private static function drawablePoolSql(): string
234    {
235        return ' FROM tsumego JOIN set_connection ON set_connection.tsumego_id = tsumego.id JOIN `set` ON set.id = set_connection.set_id'
236            . ' WHERE tsumego.deleted IS NULL AND `set`.included_in_time_mode = TRUE AND ' . SetTable::officialCondition();
237    }

239    /** @param array<int|string> $tsumegoIDs The problems of the run in the order they are played */

241    {

260    private static function deduceAttemptStatus(bool $solved, bool $timeout): int
261    {
262        if ($timeout)
263            return TimeModeAttemptStatusTable::TIMEOUT;
264        if (!$solved)
265            return TimeModeAttemptStatusTable::FAILED;
266        return TimeModeAttemptStatusTable::SOLVED;
267    }

269    //$challengeFailedLine: What was played until the fail or the time-out, which the page of a challenge shows; a
270    //run of plain time mode keeps none
271    public function processPlayResult(Tsumego $previousTsumego, bool $solved, float $seconds = 0, bool $timeout = false, ?ChallengeFailedLine $challengeFailedLine = null): void
272    {
273        if (!$this->currentSession)
274            return;
275        $attemptTable = $this->fetchTable('TimeModeAttempt');
276        $currentAttempt = $attemptTable->find()->where([
277            'time_mode_session_id' => $this->currentSession->id,
278            'tsumego_id' => $previousTsumego->id,
279            'time_mode_attempt_status_id' => TimeModeAttemptStatusTable::QUEUED])->first();
280        if (!$currentAttempt)
281            return; // this tsumego is not related to our time mode session, we ignore it
282        $seconds = $timeout ? $this->overallSecondsToSolve : min($seconds, $this->overallSecondsToSolve);
283        self::recordAttempt($currentAttempt, self::deduceAttemptStatus($solved, $timeout), $seconds,
284            $solved ? self::calculatePoints($seconds, $this->overallSecondsToSolve) : 0);
285        if (!$solved && $challengeFailedLine !== null && $this->currentSession->challenge_id !== null)
286            $challengeFailedLine->store($currentAttempt->id);
287        self::bumpChallengeOf($this->currentSession);
288        $this->currentOrder++;
289    }

291    public function skip(int $position): void
292    {
293        if (!$this->currentSession)
294            return;
295        $attempt = $this->findAttemptToSkip($position);
296        if (!$attempt)
297            return;
298        self::recordAttempt($attempt, TimeModeAttemptStatusTable::SKIPPED,
299            min($this->overallSecondsToSolve, time() - $attempt->started->getTimestamp()), 0);
300        self::bumpChallengeOf($this->currentSession);
301        $this->currentOrder++;
302    }
303
304    //The problem to give up on: the one at the given position, when it is being played.
305    private function findAttemptToSkip(int $position): ?TimeModeAttempt
306    {
307        return $this->fetchTable('TimeModeAttempt')->find()->where([
308            'time_mode_session_id' => $this->currentSession->id,
309            'order' => $position,
310            'started IS NOT' => null,
311            'time_mode_attempt_status_id' => TimeModeAttemptStatusTable::QUEUED])->orderByDesc('id')->first();
312    }
313
314    //The problem to present to the player: the one at this position when it is still open,
315    //and otherwise the first one that follows it. A problem can stay unrecorded behind the
316    //player, so when nothing from this position on is open, that is what they get to play.
317    //Returns the tsumego id to show, or null when there is nothing to play
318    public function prepareToSolve(int $position): ?int
319    {
320        if (!$this->currentSession)
321            return null;
322
323        // Past the last problem: the session is over, but its score cannot be computed
324        // while a result is still on its way.
325        if ($position > $this->overallCount && $this->hasAResultOnItsWay())
326            return null;
327
328        return $this->serve($this->findOpenAttemptFrom($position) ?: $this->findOpenAttempt());
329    }
330
331    //The problem to present when no position was asked for: the first one that is still open.
332    //Returns the tsumego id to show, or null when there is nothing to play
333    public function prepareWhateverIsLeft(): ?int
334    {
335        if (!$this->currentSession)
336            return null;
337
338        return $this->serve($this->findOpenAttempt());
339    }
340
341    //Starts the clock on the problem to play, or gives up on it when its time ran out.
342    private function serve(?TimeModeAttempt $attempt): ?int
343    {
344        $this->secondsToSolve = $this->overallSecondsToSolve;
345        $this->servedOrder = null;
346        if (!$attempt)
347            return null;
348
349        $this->servedOrder = $attempt->order;
350
351        if (!$attempt->started)
352        {
353            // in whole seconds, as date('Y-m-d H:i:s.u') stored it before (date() has no microseconds)
354            $attempt->started = new DateTimeImmutable(date('Y-m-d H:i:s'));
355            $this->fetchTable('TimeModeAttempt')->saveOrFail($attempt);
356        }
357        else
358        {
359            $start = $attempt->started;
360            $now = new DateTimeImmutable();
361
362            $secondsSinceStarted = $now->getTimestamp() + $now->format('u') / 1e6 - ($start->getTimestamp() + $start->format('u') / 1e6);
363            // whole seconds left, the part of a second already gone counts as gone
364            $this->secondsToSolve = (int) max(0, floor($this->secondsToSolve - $secondsSinceStarted));
365            if ($this->secondsToSolve == 0)
366            {
367                self::recordAttempt($attempt, TimeModeAttemptStatusTable::TIMEOUT, $this->overallSecondsToSolve, 0);
368                self::bumpChallengeOf($this->currentSession);
369                $this->currentOrder++;
370                return $this->prepareWhateverIsLeft();
371            }
372        }
373        return $attempt->tsumego_id;
374    }
375
376    //The first problem from this position on that has not been recorded yet.
377    private function findOpenAttemptFrom(int $position): ?TimeModeAttempt
378    {
379        return $this->fetchTable('TimeModeAttempt')->find()->where([
380            'time_mode_session_id' => $this->currentSession->id,
381            'order >=' => $position,
382            'time_mode_attempt_status_id' => TimeModeAttemptStatusTable::QUEUED])->orderBy('order')->first();
383    }
384
385    //The first problem of the session that has not been recorded yet.
386    private function findOpenAttempt(): ?TimeModeAttempt
387    {
388        return $this->fetchTable('TimeModeAttempt')->find()->where([
389            'time_mode_session_id' => $this->currentSession->id,
390            'time_mode_attempt_status_id' => TimeModeAttemptStatusTable::QUEUED])->orderBy('id')->first();
391    }
392
393    //True while a problem has been played but its result has not been recorded yet.
394    private function hasAResultOnItsWay(): bool
395    {
396        return $this->fetchTable('TimeModeAttempt')->exists([
397            'time_mode_session_id' => $this->currentSession->id,
398            'started IS NOT' => null,
399            'time_mode_attempt_status_id' => TimeModeAttemptStatusTable::QUEUED]);
400    }
401
402    public function currentWillBeLast(): bool
403    {
404        return $this->servedOrder !== null && $this->servedOrder == $this->overallCount;
405    }
406
407    //The position to show: the problem being presented, or when none is being
408    //presented the first one that has not been recorded yet.
409    public function currentPosition(): ?int
410    {
411        return $this->servedOrder ?? $this->currentOrder;
412    }
413
414    //True while the session is still being played, so it has no score to show yet.
415    //The score is computed from the recorded attempts, and the recording of a result
416    //lags behind the play, so a session can be over and still have attempts queued.
417    public function hasNoResultYet(int $sessionID): bool
418    {
419        if (!$this->fetchTable('TimeModeSession')->exists([
420            'id' => $sessionID,
421            'user_id' => Auth::getUserID(),
422            'time_mode_session_status_id' => TimeModeSessionStatusTable::IN_PROGRESS]))
423                return false;
424
425        return $this->fetchTable('TimeModeAttempt')->exists([
426            'time_mode_session_id' => $sessionID,
427            'time_mode_attempt_status_id' => TimeModeAttemptStatusTable::QUEUED]);
428    }
429
430    public function checkFinishSession(): ?int
431    {
432        if (!$this->currentSession)
433            return null;
434
435        if ($this->currentOrder - 1 < $this->overallCount)
436            return null;
437
438        self::score($this->currentSession);
439        return $this->currentSession->id;
440    }
441
442    //Ends a run whose every problem has its result: sums up the points and decides whether it
443    //passed, and gets the player back to the level mode.
444    private static function score(TimeModeSession $session): void
445    {
446        $attempts = TableRegistry::getTableLocator()->get('TimeModeAttempt')->find()->where(['time_mode_session_id' => $session->id])->toArray();
447
448        $overallPoints = 0.0;
449        $correctCount = 0;
450        foreach ($attempts as $attempt)
451        {
452            $overallPoints += (float) $attempt->points;
453            if ($attempt->time_mode_attempt_status_id == TimeModeAttemptStatusTable::SOLVED)
454                $correctCount++;
455        }
456
457        $sessionSuccessful = Util::getRatio($correctCount, count($attempts)) >= TimeModeUtil::RATIO_OF_SOLVED_TO_SUCCEED;
458        $session->time_mode_session_status_id = $sessionSuccessful ? TimeModeSessionStatusTable::SOLVED : TimeModeSessionStatusTable::FAILED;
459        $session->points = (string) $overallPoints;
460        TableRegistry::getTableLocator()->get('TimeModeSession')->saveOrFail($session);
461        self::bumpChallengeOf($session);
462        Auth::saveUserField('mode_id', Constants::$LEVEL_MODE);
463    }
464
465    //A run of a challenge changed: the pages showing its table learn it (Live)
466    private static function bumpChallengeOf(TimeModeSession $session): void
467    {
468        if ($session->challenge_id !== null)
469            Live::bump(Live::challengeChannel((int) $session->challenge_id));
470    }
471
472    public static function calculatePoints(float $timeUsed, float $max): float
473    {
474        $timeRatio = 1 - ($timeUsed / $max);
475        return min(100 * (TimeModeUtil::POINTS_RATIO_FOR_FINISHING + (1 - TimeModeUtil::POINTS_RATIO_FOR_FINISHING) * $timeRatio), 100.0);
476    }
